FILE: CMakeLists.txt

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

project(CipherAPI VERSION 0.7 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED)

set(CIPHERAPI_INCLUDE_DIRS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include"
)

add_library(cipher_core STATIC
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/library.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/profile.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/auth.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/image.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/video.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/commands.cpp"
)

target_include_directories(cipher_core PUBLIC ${CIPHERAPI_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(cipher_core PUBLIC OpenSSL::Crypto)

add_executable(cipher_client "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/client.cpp")
target_link_libraries(cipher_client PRIVATE cipher_core)

add_executable(cipher_server "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/server.cpp")
target_link_libraries(cipher_server PRIVATE cipher_core)


# Python SDK shared library
set_target_properties(cipher_core PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

add_library(cipherapi SHARED src/api.cpp)
target_include_directories(cipherapi PUBLIC ${CIPHERAPI_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(cipherapi PRIVATE cipher_core)

FILE: README.md
==========================================================================================
CipherAPI

<p align="center">
  **A modular C++20 TCP communication system.**
  <br>
  Custom encoding libraries · Binary image transfer · CVS/1 video protocol
</p>---

Overview

CipherAPI is a C++20 communication project built around native POSIX TCP sockets.

It provides a client-server communication system supporting encoded text messages, fast text transmission, binary image transfer, and a custom chunk-based video transfer protocol called CVS/1.

The project explores custom data transformation, protocol design, binary transport, integrity verification, and modular C++ development.

Features

- [x] Modern C++20 codebase
- [x] CMake build system
- [x] Native POSIX TCP sockets
- [x] Full-duplex client-server communication
- [x] Custom text encoding system
- [x] Ten rotating character libraries
- [x] Fast raw-text transmission mode
- [x] Binary image transmission
- [x] SHA-256 image integrity verification
- [x] Raw image transmission without SHA-256
- [x] CVS/1 chunk-based video transmission
- [x] CipherShuffle bit rearrangement
- [x] Optional SHA-256 video integrity verification
- [x] File reconstruction on the receiving side
- [x] Logging and transfer statistics

CVS/1 — Cipher Video Streaming Protocol

CVS/1 is CipherAPI's custom video file transfer protocol.

Instead of transmitting an entire video as one payload, CVS/1 processes it in chunks.

Transfer pipeline

1. Read the source video in chunks of up to 4096 bytes.
2. Convert each chunk into a bitstream.
3. Apply the custom CipherShuffle bit rearrangement.
4. Encode the transformed data using the ten character libraries.
5. Transmit the encoded chunk over TCP.
6. The receiver decodes the data and restores the original bit order.
7. Reconstruct the original video file.
8. Optionally verify the completed file using SHA-256.

Protocol capabilities

Feature| Implementation
Protocol version| CVS/1
Chunk size| 4096 bytes
Transport| TCP
Bit transformation| CipherShuffle
Encoding| Ten custom libraries
Integrity| Optional SHA-256
Reconstruction| Receiver-side

Important: CipherShuffle is a data transformation and obfuscation technique, not encryption. The protocol does not currently provide confidentiality or authenticated encryption.

Image Transfer

CipherAPI supports two image transmission modes:

- Standard image transfer with SHA-256 verification.
- Raw image transfer without SHA-256 verification.

Requirements

- C++20 compatible compiler
- CMake 3.20+
- OpenSSL development libraries
- POSIX-compatible operating system
- Linux or Termux environment

No Boost.Asio dependency is required.

Installation

Clone the repository:

git clone https://github.com/sizzly-k3vin/CipherAPI.git
cd CipherAPI

Configure:

cmake -S . -B build

Compile:

cmake --build build -j$(nproc)

Running

1. Start the server

./build/cipher_server

2. Start the client

In another terminal:

./build/cipher_client

To connect to a different server address:

./build/cipher_client SERVER_IP

The default client address is "127.0.0.1", and the server listens on port "8080".

Available Commands

Command| Description
"/help"| Display available commands
"/stats"| Display communication statistics
"/clear"| Clear terminal output
"/fast"| Toggle fast raw-text mode
"/sendimg FILE"| Send an image with SHA-256
"/sendimg -f FILE"| Send an image without SHA-256
"/sendvid FILE"| Send a video using CVS/1 with SHA-256
"/sendvid -f FILE"| Send a video using CVS/1 without SHA-256
"/quit"| Close the connection

## Authentication and Device Pairing

CipherAPI is designed to use per-device authentication keys and server-managed device records.

### Identity separation
- **Server account UUID:** Internal identifier used only by the server to group authorized devices. It is never the client display UserID.
- **Device key:** A unique, cryptographically random 256-bit key generated by the server for each device.
- **Client UserID:** A locally chosen display identifier. It is not sent as an authentication credential and does not determine permissions or identity on the server.

### First-device registration
1. The server creates an internal account record.
2. The server generates a unique device key.
3. The client securely receives and stores the key.
4. The server stores a verifier rather than the raw key.

### New-device pairing
1. The new device requests pairing.
2. The server creates a short-lived, single-use pairing code and challenge.
3. An existing authorized device approves the request using cryptographic proof.
4. The server verifies the approval and consumes the pairing request.
5. The server generates a separate device key for the new device.

### Security requirements
- Authenticate before accepting application messages or media.
- Use TLS for transport encryption and initial key delivery.
- Use fresh nonces and HMAC-SHA256 for challenge-response authentication.
- Expire pairing requests and prevent replay.
- Allow individual device revocation.
- Never use the client UserID as an authentication credential.

**Implementation status:** Design specification. These requirements are not yet implemented by this documentation update.

/* This source file must have a .cpp extension so that all C++ compilers
   recognize the extension without flags.  Borland does not know .cxx for
   example.  */
#ifndef __cplusplus
# error "A C compiler has been selected for C++."
#endif

#if !defined(__has_include)
/* If the compiler does not have __has_include, pretend the answer is
   always no.  */
#  define __has_include(x) 0
#endif


/* Version number components: V=Version, R=Revision, P=Patch
   Version date components:   YYYY=Year, MM=Month,   DD=Day  */

#if defined(__INTEL_COMPILER) || defined(__ICC)
# define COMPILER_ID "Intel"
# if defined(_MSC_VER)
#  define SIMULATE_ID "MSVC"
# endif
# if defined(__GNUC__)
#  define SIMULATE_ID "GNU"
# endif
  /* __INTEL_COMPILER = VRP prior to 2021, and then VVVV for 2021 and later,
     except that a few beta releases use the old format with V=2021.  */
# if __INTEL_COMPILER < 2021 || __INTEL_COMPILER == 202110 || __INTEL_COMPILER == 202111
#  define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER/100)
#  define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER/10 % 10)
#  if defined(__INTEL_COMPILER_UPDATE)
#   define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER_UPDATE)
#  else
#   define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER   % 10)
#  endif
# else
#  define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER)
#  define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER_UPDATE)
   /* The third version component from --version is an update index,
      but no macro is provided for it.  */
#  define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(0)
# endif
# if defined(__INTEL_COMPILER_BUILD_DATE)
   /* __INTEL_COMPILER_BUILD_DATE = YYYYMMDD */
#  define COMPILER_VERSION_TWEAK DEC(__INTEL_COMPILER_BUILD_DATE)
# endif
# if defined(_MSC_VER)
   /* _MSC_VER = VVRR */
#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(_MSC_VER / 100)
#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MINOR DEC(_MSC_VER % 100)
# endif
# if defined(__GNUC__)
#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__GNUC__)
# elif defined(__GNUG__)
#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__GNUG__)
# endif
# if defined(__GNUC_MINOR__)
#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__GNUC_MINOR__)
# endif
# if defined(__GNUC_PATCHLEVEL__)
#  define SIMULATE_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__GNUC_PATCHLEVEL__)
# endif

#elif (defined(__clang__) && defined(__INTEL_CLANG_COMPILER)) || defined(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER)
# define COMPILER_ID "IntelLLVM"
#if defined(_MSC_VER)
# define SIMULATE_ID "MSVC"
#endif
#if defined(__GNUC__)
# define SIMULATE_ID "GNU"
#endif
/* __INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER = VVVVRP prior to 2021.2.0, VVVVRRPP for 2021.2.0 and
 * later.  Look for 6 digit vs. 8 digit version number to decide encoding.
 * VVVV is no smaller than the current year when a version is released.
 */
#if __INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER < 1000000L
# define COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR DEC(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER/100)
# define COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR DEC(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER/10 % 10)
# define COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH DEC(__INTEL_LLVM_COMPILER    % 10)
#else

#  define ARCHITECTURE_ID "RH850"

# else
#  define ARCHITECTURE_ID ""
# endif

#else
#  define ARCHITECTURE_ID
#endif

/* Convert integer to decimal digit literals.  */
#define DEC(n)                   \
  ('0' + (((n) / 10000000)%10)), \
  ('0' + (((n) / 1000000)%10)),  \
  ('0' + (((n) / 100000)%10)),   \
  ('0' + (((n) / 10000)%10)),    \
  ('0' + (((n) / 1000)%10)),     \
  ('0' + (((n) / 100)%10)),      \
  ('0' + (((n) / 10)%10)),       \
  ('0' +  ((n) % 10))

/* Convert integer to hex digit literals.  */
#define HEX(n)             \
  ('0' + ((n)>>28 & 0xF)), \
  ('0' + ((n)>>24 & 0xF)), \
  ('0' + ((n)>>20 & 0xF)), \
  ('0' + ((n)>>16 & 0xF)), \
  ('0' + ((n)>>12 & 0xF)), \
  ('0' + ((n)>>8  & 0xF)), \
  ('0' + ((n)>>4  & 0xF)), \
  ('0' + ((n)     & 0xF))

/* Construct a string literal encoding the version number. */
#ifdef COMPILER_VERSION
char const* info_version = "INFO" ":" "compiler_version[" COMPILER_VERSION "]";

/* Construct a string literal encoding the version number components. */
#elif defined(COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR)
char const info_version[] = {
  'I', 'N', 'F', 'O', ':',
  'c','o','m','p','i','l','e','r','_','v','e','r','s','i','o','n','[',
  COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR,
# ifdef COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR
  '.', COMPILER_VERSION_MINOR,
#  ifdef COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH
   '.', COMPILER_VERSION_PATCH,
#   ifdef COMPILER_VERSION_TWEAK
    '.', COMPILER_VERSION_TWEAK,
#   endif
#  endif
# endif
  ']','\0'};
#endif

/* Construct a string literal encoding the internal version number. */
#ifdef COMPILER_VERSION_INTERNAL
char const info_version_internal[] = {
  'I', 'N', 'F', 'O', ':',
  'c','o','m','p','i','l','e','r','_','v','e','r','s','i','o','n','_',
  'i','n','t','e','r','n','a','l','[',
  COMPILER_VERSION_INTERNAL,']','\0'};
#elif defined(COMPILER_VERSION_INTERNAL_STR)
char const* info_version_internal = "INFO" ":" "compiler_version_internal[" COMPILER_VERSION_INTERNAL_STR "]";
#endif

/* Construct a string literal encoding the version number components. */
#ifdef SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR
char const info_simulate_version[] = {
  'I', 'N', 'F', 'O', ':',
  's','i','m','u','l','a','t','e','_','v','e','r','s','i','o','n','[',
  SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR,
# ifdef SIMULATE_VERSION_MINOR
  '.', SIMULATE_VERSION_MINOR,
#  ifdef SIMULATE_VERSION_PATCH
   '.', SIMULATE_VERSION_PATCH,
#   ifdef SIMULATE_VERSION_TWEAK
    '.', SIMULATE_VERSION_TWEAK,
#   endif
#  endif
# endif
  ']','\0'};
#endif

/* Construct the string literal in pieces to prevent the source from
   getting matched.  Store it in a pointer rather than an array
   because some compilers will just produce instructions to fill the
   array rather than assigning a pointer to a static array.  */
char const* info_platform = "INFO" ":" "platform[" PLATFORM_ID "]";
char const* info_arch = "INFO" ":" "arch[" ARCHITECTURE_ID "]";



#define CXX_STD_98 199711L
#define CXX_STD_11 201103L
#define CXX_STD_14 201402L
#define CXX_STD_17 201703L
#define CXX_STD_20 202002L
#define CXX_STD_23 202302L

#if defined(__INTEL_COMPILER) && defined(_MSVC_LANG)
#  if _MSVC_LANG > CXX_STD_17
#    define CXX_STD _MSVC_LANG
#  elif _MSVC_LANG == CXX_STD_17 && defined(__cpp_aggregate_paren_init)
#    define CXX_STD CXX_STD_20
#  elif _MSVC_LANG > CXX_STD_14 && __cplusplus > CXX_STD_17
#    define CXX_STD CXX_STD_20
#  elif _MSVC_LANG > CXX_STD_14
#    define CXX_STD CXX_STD_17
#  elif defined(__INTEL_CXX11_MODE__) && defined(__cpp_aggregate_nsdmi)
#    define CXX_STD CXX_STD_14
#  elif defined(__INTEL_CXX11_MODE__)
#    define CXX_STD CXX_STD_11
#  else
#    define CXX_STD CXX_STD_98
#  endif
#elif defined(_MSC_VER) && defined(_MSVC_LANG)
#  if _MSVC_LANG > __cplusplus
#    define CXX_STD _MSVC_LANG
#  else
#    define CXX_STD __cplusplus
#  endif
#elif defined(__NVCOMPILER)
#  if __cplusplus == CXX_STD_17 && defined(__cpp_aggregate_paren_init)
#    define CXX_STD CXX_STD_20
#  else
#    define CXX_STD __cplusplus
#  endif
#elif defined(__INTEL_COMPILER) || defined(__PGI)
#  if __cplusplus == CXX_STD_11 && defined(__cpp_namespace_attributes)
#    define CXX_STD CXX_STD_17
#  elif __cplusplus == CXX_STD_11 && defined(__cpp_aggregate_nsdmi)
#    define CXX_STD CXX_STD_14
#  else
#    define CXX_STD __cplusplus
#  endif
#elif (defined(__IBMCPP__) || defined(__ibmxl__)) && defined(__linux__)
#  if __cplusplus == CXX_STD_11 && defined(__cpp_aggregate_nsdmi)
#    define CXX_STD CXX_STD_14
#  else
#    define CXX_STD __cplusplus
#  endif
#elif __cplusplus == 1 && defined(__GXX_EXPERIMENTAL_CXX0X__)
#  define CXX_STD CXX_STD_11
#else
#  define CXX_STD __cplusplus
#endif

const char* info_language_standard_default = "INFO" ":" "standard_default["
#if CXX_STD > CXX_STD_23
  "26"
#elif CXX_STD > CXX_STD_20
  "23"
#elif CXX_STD > CXX_STD_17
  "20"
#elif CXX_STD > CXX_STD_14
  "17"
#elif CXX_STD > CXX_STD_11
  "14"
#elif CXX_STD >= CXX_STD_11
  "11"
#else
  "98"
#endif
"]";

const char* info_language_extensions_default = "INFO" ":" "extensions_default["
#if (defined(__clang__) || defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__xlC__) ||           \
     defined(__TI_COMPILER_VERSION__) || defined(__RENESAS__)) &&             \
  !defined(__STRICT_ANSI__)
  "ON"
#else
  "OFF"
#endif
"]";

/*--------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

int main(int argc, char* argv[])
{
  int require = 0;
  require += info_compiler[argc];
  require += info_platform[argc];
  require += info_arch[argc];
#ifdef COMPILER_VERSION_MAJOR
  require += info_version[argc];
#endif
#if defined(COMPILER_VERSION_INTERNAL) || defined(COMPILER_VERSION_INTERNAL_STR)
  require += info_version_internal[argc];
#endif
#ifdef SIMULATE_ID
  require += info_simulate[argc];
#endif
#ifdef SIMULATE_VERSION_MAJOR
  require += info_simulate_version[argc];
#endif
#if defined(__CRAYXT_COMPUTE_LINUX_TARGET)
  require += info_cray[argc];
#endif
  require += info_language_standard_default[argc];
  require += info_language_extensions_default[argc];
  (void)argv;
  return require;
}

  set(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX "/usr/local")
endif()

    string(REGEX REPLACE "^[^A-Za-z0-9_]+" ""
           CMAKE_INSTALL_CONFIG_NAME "${BUILD_TYPE}")
  else()
    set(CMAKE_INSTALL_CONFIG_NAME "RelWithDebInfo")
  endif()

endif()

    message(STATUS "Install component: \"${COMPONENT}\"")
    set(CMAKE_INSTALL_COMPONENT "${COMPONENT}")
  else()
    set(CMAKE_INSTALL_COMPONENT)
  endif()
endif()

# Install shared libraries without execute permission?

  set(CMAKE_INSTALL_SO_NO_EXE "0")
endif()

# Is this installation the result of a crosscompile?

  set(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING "FALSE")

# Set path to fallback-tool for dependency-resolution.

endif()

       "${CMAKE_INSTALL_MANIFEST_FILES}")

     "${CMAKE_INSTALL_MANIFEST_CONTENT}")

#include "auth.hpp"
#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    AuthStore auth("cipher_test_users.db");
    std::string key, id;

    if (!auth.register_user("test_user", key, id)) return 1;

    std::string verified_id;
    if (!auth.authenticate("test_user", key, verified_id)) return 2;
    if (id != verified_id) return 3;
    {
        AuthStore restarted("cipher_test_users.db");
        std::string after_restart;
        if (!restarted.authenticate("test_user", key, after_restart)) return 4;
        if (after_restart != id) return 5;
    }

    std::cout << "Registration: PASS\\n";
    std::cout << "Authentication: PASS\\n";
    std::cout << "UserID consistency: PASS\\n";
    std::cout << "Restart persistence: PASS\\n";
}

FILE: docs/AUTHENTICATION_DESIGN.md

# CipherAPI Authentication Design


## Authentication and Device Pairing

CipherAPI is designed to use per-device authentication keys and server-managed device records.

### Identity separation
- **Server account UUID:** Internal identifier used only by the server to group authorized devices. It is never the client display UserID.
- **Device key:** A unique, cryptographically random 256-bit key generated by the server for each device.
- **Client UserID:** A locally chosen display identifier. It is not sent as an authentication credential and does not determine permissions or identity on the server.

### First-device registration
1. The server creates an internal account record.
2. The server generates a unique device key.
3. The client securely receives and stores the key.
4. The server stores a verifier rather than the raw key.

### New-device pairing
1. The new device requests pairing.
2. The server creates a short-lived, single-use pairing code and challenge.
3. An existing authorized device approves the request using cryptographic proof.
4. The server verifies the approval and consumes the pairing request.
5. The server generates a separate device key for the new device.

### Security requirements
- Authenticate before accepting application messages or media.
- Use TLS for transport encryption and initial key delivery.
- Use fresh nonces and HMAC-SHA256 for challenge-response authentication.
- Expire pairing requests and prevent replay.
- Allow individual device revocation.
- Never use the client UserID as an authentication credential.

**Implementation status:** Design specification. These requirements are not yet implemented by this documentation update.

#pragma once

#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>

class AuthStore {
public:
    explicit AuthStore(const std::string& path = "users.db");

    bool register_user(const std::string& username, std::string& ckey);
    bool register_user(const std::string& username, std::string& ckey,
                       std::string& user_id);

    bool authenticate(const std::string& username,
                      const std::string& ckey) const;
    bool authenticate(const std::string& username,
                      const std::string& ckey,
                      std::string& user_id) const;

private:
    struct UserRecord {
        std::string user_id;
        std::string ckey_hash;
    };

    std::string path;
    mutable std::mutex mutex;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, UserRecord> users;

    static bool valid_username(const std::string& username);
    static std::string hash_key(const std::string& key);
    static std::string generate_user_id();
    void save_locked() const;
};

#pragma once
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

typedef struct CAPIClient CAPIClient;

CAPIClient* capi_client_create(
    const char* host,
    uint16_t port,
    const char* library_directory
);

int capi_client_connect(CAPIClient* client);
int capi_client_send_text(CAPIClient* client, const char* message, int fast);
int capi_client_send_image(CAPIClient* client, const char* path, int raw);
int capi_client_send_video(CAPIClient* client, const char* path, int checksum);
int capi_client_receive_event(
    CAPIClient* client, int* event_type,
    char* buffer, size_t capacity, int timeout_ms
);

/* Returns received byte count, -2 on timeout, or -1 on error.
   The output buffer is null-terminated when capacity permits. */
int capi_client_receive(
    CAPIClient* client,
    char* buffer,
    size_t capacity,
    int timeout_ms
);

void capi_client_close(CAPIClient* client);
void capi_client_destroy(CAPIClient* client);
const char* capi_last_error(void);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

==========================================================================================

==========================================================================================
#pragma once
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <iostream>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <source_location>
#include <string_view>

namespace CipherDebug {
inline std::mutex mutex;

inline bool enabled() {
    const char* v = std::getenv("CIPHER_DEBUG");
    return v && std::string_view(v) == "1";
}

inline void log(std::string_view level, std::string_view msg,
                const std::source_location loc =
                    std::source_location::current()) {

    auto now = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
    auto ms = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
        now.time_since_epoch()) % 1000;

    std::lock_guard lock(mutex);
    std::cerr << "[" << level << "] "
              << std::chrono::system_clock::to_time_t(now)
              << "." << ms.count()
              << " [T:" << std::this_thread::get_id() << "] "
              << loc.file_name() << ":" << loc.line()
              << " | " << loc.function_name()
              << " | " << msg << '\n';
}
}

#define CDEBUG(msg) CipherDebug::log("DEBUG", msg)
#define CINFO(msg) CipherDebug::log("INFO", msg)
#define CWARN(msg) CipherDebug::log("WARN", msg)
#define CERROR(msg) CipherDebug::log("ERROR", msg)

#pragma once
#include <chrono>
#include <cerrno>
#include <ctime>
#include <iomanip>
#include <iostream>
#include <mutex>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <system_error>

namespace CipherLog {
inline std::mutex log_mutex;

inline void write(const char* level, const std::string& message,
                  std::ostream& output) {
    const auto now = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
    const auto time = std::chrono::system_clock::to_time_t(now);
    std::tm local{};
    localtime_r(&time, &local);

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(log_mutex);
    output << '[' << std::put_time(&local, "%H:%M:%S")
           << "] [" << level << "] " << message << '\n';
    output.flush();
}


inline const char* errno_name(int code) {
    if (code == EADDRINUSE) return "EADDRINUSE";
    if (code == EADDRNOTAVAIL) return "EADDRNOTAVAIL";
    if (code == EACCES) return "EACCES";
    if (code == EBADF) return "EBADF";
    if (code == EINTR) return "EINTR";
    if (code == EINVAL) return "EINVAL";
    if (code == EMFILE) return "EMFILE";
    if (code == ENFILE) return "ENFILE";
    if (code == ENOMEM) return "ENOMEM";
    if (code == ENOBUFS) return "ENOBUFS";
    if (code == ECONNREFUSED) return "ECONNREFUSED";
    if (code == ECONNRESET) return "ECONNRESET";
    if (code == ETIMEDOUT) return "ETIMEDOUT";
    if (code == EPIPE) return "EPIPE";
    if (code == ENOTCONN) return "ENOTCONN";
    return "UNKNOWN";
}

inline void system_error(const std::string& id,
                         const std::string& operation,
                         int code) {
    const std::string detail =
        std::error_code(code, std::generic_category()).message();

    write("ERROR",
          "[" + id + "] " + operation +
          " | errno=" + std::to_string(code) +
          " | name=" + errno_name(code) +
          " | detail=" + detail,
          std::cerr);
}

inline void info(const std::string& s)    { write("INFO", s, std::cout); }
inline void error(const std::string& s)   { write("FAIL", s, std::cerr); }
inline void network(const std::string& s) { write("NET ", s, std::cout); }
inline void encode(const std::string& s)  { write("ENC ", s, std::cout); }
inline void decode(const std::string& s)  { write("DEC ", s, std::cout); }
inline void send(const std::string& s)    { write("SEND", s, std::cout); }
inline void receive(const std::string& s) { write("RECV", s, std::cout); }

inline void banner(const std::string& role) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(log_mutex);
    std::cout
        << "\n"
        << "  ========================================\n"
        << "          C I P H E R A P I\n"
        << "             VERSION 0.7\n"
        << "  ========================================\n"
        << "  MODE: " << role << '\n'
        << "  TRANSPORT: TCP / FULL DUPLEX\n"
        << "  ENCODING: EXPERIMENTAL TOKEN MAPPING\n"
        << "  ========================================\n\n";
}
}

    std::atomic<unsigned long long> received_messages{0};

#pragma once

#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdint>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>

namespace CipherTransport {

enum FrameType : uint8_t {
    TEXT = 1,
    IMAGE = 2,
    FAST_TEXT = 3,
    RAW_IMAGE = 4,
    VIDEO_START = 5,
    VIDEO_DATA = 6,
    VIDEO_END = 7,
    AUTH_REGISTER = 8,
    AUTH_LOGIN = 9,
    AUTH_OK = 10,
    AUTH_FAIL = 11
};

constexpr uint32_t MAX_TEXT_FRAME = 1024 * 1024;
constexpr uint32_t MAX_IMAGE_FRAME = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
constexpr uint32_t MAX_VIDEO_FRAME = 4 * 1024 * 1024;

inline bool valid_type(uint8_t type) {
    return type == TEXT || type == IMAGE ||
           type == FAST_TEXT || type == RAW_IMAGE ||
           type == VIDEO_START || type == VIDEO_DATA ||
           type == VIDEO_END || type == AUTH_REGISTER ||
           type == AUTH_LOGIN || type == AUTH_OK ||
           type == AUTH_FAIL;
}

inline uint32_t frame_limit(uint8_t type) {
    if (type == VIDEO_START || type == VIDEO_DATA ||
        type == VIDEO_END)
        return MAX_VIDEO_FRAME;

    return (type == IMAGE || type == RAW_IMAGE)
        ? MAX_IMAGE_FRAME : MAX_TEXT_FRAME;
}

inline bool receive_exact(int fd, void* data, size_t size) {
    char* ptr = static_cast<char*>(data);
    size_t received = 0;

    while (received < size) {
        ssize_t n = recv(fd, ptr + received, size - received, 0);
        if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
        if (n == 0 && received == 0) return false;
        if (n <= 0) throw std::runtime_error("Incomplete TCP frame");
        received += static_cast<size_t>(n);
    }
    return true;
}

inline void send_exact(int fd, const void* data, size_t size) {
    const char* ptr = static_cast<const char*>(data);
    size_t sent = 0;

    while (sent < size) {
#ifdef MSG_NOSIGNAL
        ssize_t n = ::send(fd, ptr + sent, size - sent, MSG_NOSIGNAL);
#else
        ssize_t n = ::send(fd, ptr + sent, size - sent, 0);
#endif
        if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
        if (n <= 0) throw std::runtime_error("TCP send failed");
        sent += static_cast<size_t>(n);
    }
}

inline void send_frame(int fd, FrameType type,
                       const std::string& payload) {
    uint8_t packet_type = static_cast<uint8_t>(type);

    if (!valid_type(packet_type))
        throw std::runtime_error("Unknown outgoing frame type");

    if (payload.size() > frame_limit(packet_type))
        throw std::runtime_error("Frame exceeds size limit");

    if (type == TEXT && payload.size() % 64 != 0)
        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid encoded text payload");

    uint32_t length = htonl(static_cast<uint32_t>(payload.size()));

    send_exact(fd, &packet_type, sizeof(packet_type));
    send_exact(fd, &length, sizeof(length));

    if (!payload.empty())
        send_exact(fd, payload.data(), payload.size());
}

inline bool receive_frame(int fd, uint8_t& type,
                          std::string& payload) {
    uint32_t network_length = 0;

    if (!receive_exact(fd, &type, sizeof(type)))
        return false;

    if (!receive_exact(fd, &network_length, sizeof(network_length)))
        throw std::runtime_error("Incomplete frame header");

    if (!valid_type(type))
        throw std::runtime_error("Unknown packet type");

    uint32_t length = ntohl(network_length);

    if (length > frame_limit(type))
        throw std::runtime_error("Incoming frame exceeds size limit");

    if (type == TEXT && length % 64 != 0)
        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid encoded text frame");

    payload.resize(length);

    if (length && !receive_exact(fd, payload.data(), length))
        throw std::runtime_error("Incomplete frame payload");

    return true;
}

}

namespace CipherVideo {

constexpr std::uint32_t CHUNK_SIZE = 4096;
constexpr std::uint64_t MAX_VIDEO_SIZE = 2ULL * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;

struct TransferStats {
    std::uint64_t original_bytes = 0;
    std::uint64_t wire_bytes = 0;
    std::uint32_t chunks = 0;
};

TransferStats send_file(
    int fd,
    const LibraryManager& libraries,
    const std::string& path,
    bool use_sha256,
    bool fast_mode
);

class Receiver {
public:
    explicit Receiver(const LibraryManager& libraries);
    ~Receiver();

    Receiver(const Receiver&) = delete;
    Receiver& operator=(const Receiver&) = delete;

    // Returns the saved filename when VIDEO_END completes a transfer.
    std::string handle(std::uint8_t type, const std::string& payload);
    void abort() noexcept;

private:
    const LibraryManager& libraries_;
    bool active_ = false;
    bool use_sha256_ = false;
    bool fast_mode_ = false;
    std::uint64_t expected_size_ = 0;
    std::uint64_t received_size_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t expected_sequence_ = 0;
    std::string final_path_;
    std::string temporary_path_;
    class State;
    State* state_ = nullptr;

    void abort_transfer() noexcept;
};

      draganddrop <x1> <y1> <x2> <y2> [duration(ms)] (Default: touchscreen)
      press (Default: trackball)
      roll <dx> <dy> (Default: trackball)
      motionevent <DOWN|UP|MOVE|CANCEL> <x> <y> (Default: touchscreen)
      keycombination [-t duration(ms)] <key code 1> <key code 2> ... (Default: keyboard, the key order is important here.)

FILE: patch_video.py

from pathlib import Path
import re

CLIENT = Path("src/client.cpp")
SERVER = Path("src/server.cpp")

sender = r'''
static void transmit_video(int fd, const LibraryManager& libraries,
                           Neon::Stats& stats, const std::string& path,
                           bool use_sha256) {
    const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    auto result = CipherVideo::send_file(
        fd, libraries, path, use_sha256
    );

    const auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    const double seconds =
        std::chrono::duration<double>(end - start).count();

    ++stats.sent_messages;
    stats.sent_bytes += result.wire_bytes;

    Neon::info(
        "CVS/1 | " + std::to_string(result.original_bytes) +
        " original bytes | " + std::to_string(result.wire_bytes) +
        " wire bytes | " + std::to_string(result.chunks) +
        " chunks | " + std::to_string(seconds) + " seconds"
    );

    Neon::send(
        use_sha256
            ? "Video transmitted with SHA-256"
            : "Video transmitted without SHA-256"
    );
}

'''

def replace_once(source, pattern, replacement, label):
    updated, count = re.subn(pattern, replacement, source, count=1,
                             flags=re.MULTILINE)
    if count != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{label}: expected one match, found {count}")
    return updated

def patch_file(path, main_pattern, command_fd):
    source = path.read_text()

    if '#include "video.hpp"' in source:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{path}: video.hpp already included; refusing duplicate patch")

    source = replace_once(
        source,
        r'^#include "neon\.hpp"\s*$',
        '#include "neon.hpp"\n#include "video.hpp"',
        f"{path}: include"
    )

    source = replace_once(
        source,
        main_pattern,
        sender + r'\g<0>',
        f"{path}: sender function"
    )

    # Add a persistent receiver object inside the receiving thread.
    thread_pattern = r'^([ \t]*)std::thread receiver\(\[&\]\(\) \{\s*try \{'
    def thread_replacement(match):
        indent = match.group(1)
        return (
            indent + 'std::thread receiver([&]() {\n'
            + indent + '    CipherVideo::Receiver video_receiver(libraries);\n'
            + indent + '    try {'
        )

    source = replace_once(
        source, thread_pattern, thread_replacement,
        f"{path}: receiver object"
    )

    # Add the CVS/1 receive branch before the existing IMAGE branch.
    image_pattern = r'^([ \t]*)else if \(type == CipherTransport::IMAGE\) \{'
    def image_replacement(match):
        indent = match.group(1)
        branch = (
            indent + 'else if (type == CipherTransport::VIDEO_START ||\n'
            + indent + '         type == CipherTransport::VIDEO_DATA ||\n'
            + indent + '         type == CipherTransport::VIDEO_END) {\n'
            + indent + '    if (type == CipherTransport::VIDEO_START)\n'
            + indent + '        Neon::receive("CVS/1 video transfer started");\n\n'
            + indent + '    std::string saved = video_receiver.handle(type, payload);\n\n'
            + indent + '    if (!saved.empty()) {\n'
            + indent + '        ++stats.received_messages;\n'
            + indent + '        Neon::decode("CVS/1 video reconstructed");\n'
            + indent + '        Neon::print_message("VIDEO", "Saved to " + saved);\n'
            + indent + '    }\n'
            + indent + '}\n'
        )
        return branch + match.group(0)

    source = replace_once(
        source, image_pattern, image_replacement,
        f"{path}: video receive branch"
    )

    # Add /sendvid before /sendimg.
    command_pattern = r'^([ \t]*)if \(message\.rfind\("/sendimg ", 0\) == 0\) \{'
    def command_replacement(match):
        indent = match.group(1)
        inner = indent + '    '
        block = (
            indent + 'if (message.rfind("/sendvid ", 0) == 0) {\n'
            + inner + 'std::string argument = message.substr(9);\n'
            + inner + 'bool no_sha = argument.rfind("-f ", 0) == 0;\n'
            + inner + 'std::string path = no_sha ? argument.substr(3) : argument;\n\n'
            + inner + 'if (path.size() >= 2 && path.front() == \'"\' && path.back() == \'"\')\n'
            + inner + '    path = path.substr(1, path.size() - 2);\n\n'
            + inner + 'try {\n'
            + inner + '    transmit_video(' + command_fd + ', libraries, stats, path, !no_sha);\n'
            + inner + '} catch (const std::exception& e) {\n'
            + inner + '    Neon::error(e.what());\n'
            + inner + '}\n'
            + inner + 'continue;\n'
            + indent + '}\n\n'
        )
        return block + match.group(0)

    source = replace_once(
        source, command_pattern, command_replacement,
        f"{path}: sendvid command"
    )

    return source

def main():
    if "video.cpp" not in Path("CMakeLists.txt").read_text():
        raise RuntimeError("CMakeLists.txt does not include src/video.cpp")

    transport = Path("include/transport.hpp").read_text()
    for frame in ("VIDEO_START", "VIDEO_DATA", "VIDEO_END"):
        if frame not in transport:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Transport is missing {frame}")

    client_original = CLIENT.read_text()
    server_original = SERVER.read_text()

    # Build both patched versions in memory before writing either.
    client_new = patch_file(
        CLIENT,
        r'^int main\(int argc, char\* argv\[\]\) \{',
        "sock"
    )
    server_new = patch_file(
        SERVER,
        r'^int main\(\) \{',
        "client"
    )

    # Backups, then writes.
    CLIENT.with_suffix(".cpp.pre_video.bak").write_text(client_original)
    SERVER.with_suffix(".cpp.pre_video.bak").write_text(server_original)

    CLIENT.write_text(client_new)
    SERVER.write_text(server_new)

    print("CVS/1 integration patch applied successfully.")
    print("Backups: src/client.cpp.pre_video.bak")
    print("         src/server.cpp.pre_video.bak")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

FILE: python/cipherapi.py

import ctypes
import os
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
LIBRARY = Path(os.environ.get(
    "CIPHERAPI_LIBRARY", ROOT / "build" / "libcipherapi.so"
))

_lib = ctypes.CDLL(str(LIBRARY))
_lib.capi_last_error.restype = ctypes.c_char_p

_lib.capi_client_create.argtypes = [
    ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_uint16, ctypes.c_char_p
]
_lib.capi_client_create.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
_lib.capi_client_connect.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
_lib.capi_client_connect.restype = ctypes.c_int
_lib.capi_client_send_text.argtypes = [
    ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int
]
_lib.capi_client_send_text.restype = ctypes.c_int

_lib.capi_client_send_image.argtypes = [
    ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int
]
_lib.capi_client_send_image.restype = ctypes.c_int
_lib.capi_client_send_video.argtypes = [
    ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int
]
_lib.capi_client_send_video.restype = ctypes.c_int
_lib.capi_client_receive_event.argtypes = [
    ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int),
    ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_int
]
_lib.capi_client_receive_event.restype = ctypes.c_int

_lib.capi_client_receive.argtypes = [
    ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_int
]
_lib.capi_client_receive.restype = ctypes.c_int
_lib.capi_client_close.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
_lib.capi_client_destroy.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]


def _error():
    value = _lib.capi_last_error()
    return value.decode(errors="replace") if value else "Unknown error"


class _SendMode:
    def __init__(self, client, fast):
        self._client = client
        self._fast = fast

    def __call__(self, message):
        return self._client._send(message, fast=self._fast)


class _SendDispatcher:
    def __init__(self, client):
        self._client = client
        self.ft = _SendMode(client, True)
        self.ff = _SendMode(client, False)

    def __call__(self, message, fast=False):
        return self._client._send(message, fast=fast)


class Client:
    def __init__(self, host="127.0.0.1", port=8080, library_dir=None):
        self._handle = None
        self._closed = False
        self.send = _SendDispatcher(self)
        directory = Path(library_dir or ROOT / "libraries")
        self._handle = _lib.capi_client_create(
            host.encode(), port, str(directory).encode()
        )
        if not self._handle:
            raise RuntimeError(_error())

    def connect(self):
        if self._closed:
            raise RuntimeError("Client is closed")
        if _lib.capi_client_connect(self._handle) != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(_error())
        return self

    def _send(self, message, fast=False):
        if self._closed:
            raise RuntimeError("Client is closed")
        if not isinstance(message, str):
            raise TypeError("message must be a string")
        if "\x00" in message:
            raise ValueError("NUL characters are not supported")
        if _lib.capi_client_send_text(
            self._handle, message.encode("utf-8"), int(bool(fast))
        ) != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(_error())

    def send_image(self, path, raw=False):
        if self._closed:
            raise RuntimeError("Client is closed")
        result = _lib.capi_client_send_image(
            self._handle, os.fsencode(path), int(bool(raw))
        )
        if result != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(_error())

    def send_video(self, path, checksum=True):
        if self._closed:
            raise RuntimeError("Client is closed")
        result = _lib.capi_client_send_video(
            self._handle, os.fsencode(path), int(bool(checksum))
        )
        if result != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(_error())

    def receive_event(self, timeout=1.0):
        if self._closed:
            raise RuntimeError("Client is closed")

        timeout_ms = -1 if timeout is None else max(0, int(timeout * 1000))
        buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(1024 * 1024 + 1)
        event_type = ctypes.c_int()

        result = _lib.capi_client_receive_event(
            self._handle,
            ctypes.byref(event_type),
            buffer,
            ctypes.sizeof(buffer),
            timeout_ms
        )

        if result == -2:
            return None
        if result < 0:
            raise RuntimeError(_error())

        value = buffer.raw[:result].decode("utf-8")
        names = {1: "text", 2: "image", 3: "video"}
        return names.get(event_type.value, "unknown"), value

    def receive(self, timeout=1.0):
        if self._closed:
            raise RuntimeError("Client is closed")
        timeout_ms = -1 if timeout is None else max(0, int(timeout * 1000))
        buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(1024 * 1024 + 1)
        result = _lib.capi_client_receive(
            self._handle, buffer, ctypes.sizeof(buffer), timeout_ms
        )
        if result == -2:
            return None
        if result < 0:
            raise RuntimeError(_error())
        return buffer.raw[:result].decode("utf-8")

    def close(self):
        if not self._closed:
            _lib.capi_client_close(self._handle)
            _lib.capi_client_destroy(self._handle)
            self._handle = None
            self._closed = True

    def __enter__(self):
        return self.connect()

    def __exit__(self, *args):
        self.close()

    def __del__(self):
        try:
            self.close()
        except Exception:
            pass

#include "cipherapi.h"
#include "library.hpp"
#include "transport.hpp"
#include "image.hpp"
#include "video.hpp"

#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <netdb.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include <cerrno>
#include <chrono>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>

struct CAPIClient {
    std::string host;
    uint16_t port;
    std::unique_ptr<LibraryManager> libraries;
    std::unique_ptr<CipherVideo::Receiver> video_receiver;
    int fd = -1;
    std::mutex send_mutex;
    std::mutex receive_mutex;

    CAPIClient(const char* h, uint16_t p, const char* directory)
        : host(h), port(p),
          libraries(std::make_unique<LibraryManager>(directory)) {
        video_receiver =
            std::make_unique<CipherVideo::Receiver>(*libraries);
    }
};

static thread_local std::string last_error;

static void set_error(const char* message) {
    last_error = message ? message : "Unknown CipherAPI error";
}

class FrameTimeoutError : public std::runtime_error {
public:
    using std::runtime_error::runtime_error;
};

static bool wait_readable_until(
    int fd, std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point deadline, bool infinite
) {
    while (true) {
        int timeout = -1;

        if (!infinite) {
            auto remaining = deadline - std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            auto ms = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
                remaining
            ).count();

            if (remaining > std::chrono::steady_clock::duration::zero() &&
                ms == 0)
                ms = 1;

            if (ms < 0)
                ms = 0;

            timeout = ms > INT_MAX ? INT_MAX : static_cast<int>(ms);
        }

        pollfd descriptor{fd, POLLIN, 0};
        int result = poll(&descriptor, 1, timeout);

        if (result < 0 && errno == EINTR)
            continue;

        if (result < 0)
            throw std::runtime_error("Socket poll failed");

        if (result == 0)
            return false;

        if (descriptor.revents & POLLNVAL)
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid socket descriptor");

        return true;
    }
}

static bool receive_exact_until(
    int fd, void* data, size_t size,
    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point deadline,
    bool infinite, bool allow_initial_timeout
) {
    char* ptr = static_cast<char*>(data);
    size_t received = 0;

    while (received < size) {
        if (!wait_readable_until(fd, deadline, infinite)) {
            if (received == 0 && allow_initial_timeout)
                return false;

            throw FrameTimeoutError(
                "Receive timed out during an incomplete frame"
            );
        }

        ssize_t n = recv(
            fd, ptr + received, size - received, MSG_DONTWAIT
        );

        if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR)
            continue;

        if (n < 0 && (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK))
            continue;

        if (n == 0)
            throw std::runtime_error("Server closed the connection");

        if (n < 0)
            throw std::runtime_error("TCP receive failed");

        received += static_cast<size_t>(n);
    }

    return true;
}

static bool receive_frame_until(
    int fd, uint8_t& type, std::string& payload,
    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point deadline, bool infinite
) {
    uint32_t network_length = 0;

    if (!receive_exact_until(
            fd, &type, sizeof(type), deadline, infinite, true
        ))
        return false;

    receive_exact_until(
        fd, &network_length, sizeof(network_length),
        deadline, infinite, false
    );

    if (!CipherTransport::valid_type(type))
        throw std::runtime_error("Unknown packet type");

    uint32_t length = ntohl(network_length);

    if (length > CipherTransport::frame_limit(type))
        throw std::runtime_error("Incoming frame exceeds size limit");

    if (type == CipherTransport::TEXT && length % 64 != 0)
        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid encoded text frame");

    payload.resize(length);

    if (length) {
        receive_exact_until(
            fd, payload.data(), length, deadline, infinite, false
        );
    }

    return true;
}

extern "C" {

const char* capi_last_error(void) {
    return last_error.c_str();
}

CAPIClient* capi_client_create(
    const char* host, uint16_t port, const char* library_directory
) {
    try {
        if (!host || !*host || !library_directory || !*library_directory)
            throw std::invalid_argument("Host and library directory are required");

        last_error.clear();
        return new CAPIClient(host, port, library_directory);
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        set_error(e.what());
        return nullptr;
    } catch (...) {
        set_error("Unknown error creating CipherAPI client");
        return nullptr;
    }
}

int capi_client_connect(CAPIClient* client) {
    try {
        if (!client)
            throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid client handle");

        if (client->fd >= 0)
            return 0;

        addrinfo hints{};
        hints.ai_family = AF_UNSPEC;
        hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;

        addrinfo* result = nullptr;
        const std::string service = std::to_string(client->port);

        int status = getaddrinfo(
            client->host.c_str(), service.c_str(), &hints, &result
        );

        if (status != 0)
            throw std::runtime_error(gai_strerror(status));

        int connected_fd = -1;

        for (addrinfo* item = result; item; item = item->ai_next) {
            int candidate = socket(
                item->ai_family, item->ai_socktype, item->ai_protocol
            );

            if (candidate < 0)
                continue;

            if (::connect(candidate, item->ai_addr, item->ai_addrlen) == 0) {
                connected_fd = candidate;
                break;
            }

            ::close(candidate);
        }

        freeaddrinfo(result);

        if (connected_fd < 0)
            throw std::runtime_error("Could not connect to CipherAPI server");

        client->fd = connected_fd;
        last_error.clear();
        return 0;
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        set_error(e.what());
        return -1;
    } catch (...) {
        set_error("Unknown connection error");
        return -1;
    }
}

int capi_client_send_text(CAPIClient* client, const char* message, int fast) {
    try {
        if (!client || !message)
            throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid client or message");

        if (client->fd < 0)
            throw std::runtime_error("Client is not connected");

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(client->send_mutex);
        std::string text(message);

        if (fast) {
            CipherTransport::send_frame(
                client->fd, CipherTransport::FAST_TEXT, text
            );
        } else {
            std::string encoded = client->libraries->encode(text);
            CipherTransport::send_frame(
                client->fd, CipherTransport::TEXT, encoded
            );
        }

        last_error.clear();
        return 0;
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        set_error(e.what());
        return -1;
    } catch (...) {
        set_error("Unknown text send error");
        return -1;
    }
}

int capi_client_send_image(CAPIClient* client, const char* path, int raw) {
    try {
        if (!client || !path || !*path)
            throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid image path");

        if (client->fd < 0)
            throw std::runtime_error("Client is not connected");

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(client->send_mutex);

        std::string packet = raw
            ? ImageLibrary::pack_raw(path)
            : ImageLibrary::pack(path);

        auto type = raw
            ? CipherTransport::RAW_IMAGE
            : CipherTransport::IMAGE;

        CipherTransport::send_frame(client->fd, type, packet);

        last_error.clear();
        return 0;
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        set_error(e.what());
        return -1;
    } catch (...) {
        set_error("Unknown image send error");
        return -1;
    }
}

int capi_client_send_video(CAPIClient* client, const char* path, int checksum) {
    try {
        if (!client || !path || !*path)
            throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid video path");

        if (client->fd < 0)
            throw std::runtime_error("Client is not connected");

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(client->send_mutex);

        CipherVideo::send_file(
            client->fd, *client->libraries, path, checksum != 0, false
        );

        last_error.clear();
        return 0;
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        set_error(e.what());
        return -1;
    } catch (...) {
        set_error("Unknown video send error");
        return -1;
    }
}

int capi_client_receive_event(
    CAPIClient* client, int* event_type,
    char* buffer, size_t capacity, int timeout_ms
) {
    try {
        if (!client || !event_type || !buffer || capacity == 0)
            throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid receive arguments");

        if (client->fd < 0)
            throw std::runtime_error("Client is not connected");

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(client->receive_mutex);

        const bool infinite_timeout = timeout_ms < 0;
        const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() +
            std::chrono::milliseconds(timeout_ms > 0 ? timeout_ms : 0);

        while (true) {
            uint8_t type = 0;
            std::string payload;

            if (!receive_frame_until(
                    client->fd, type, payload, deadline, infinite_timeout
                ))
                return -2;

            int kind = 0;
            std::string output;

            if (type == CipherTransport::TEXT) {
                output = client->libraries->decode(payload);
                kind = 1;
            } else if (type == CipherTransport::FAST_TEXT) {
                output = std::move(payload);
                kind = 1;
            } else if (type == CipherTransport::IMAGE) {
                output = ImageLibrary::unpack(
                    payload, "received_images"
                );
                kind = 2;
            } else if (type == CipherTransport::RAW_IMAGE) {
                output = ImageLibrary::unpack_raw(
                    payload, "received_images"
                );
                kind = 2;
            } else if (
                type >= CipherTransport::VIDEO_START &&
                type <= CipherTransport::VIDEO_END
            ) {
                try {
                    output = client->video_receiver->handle(type, payload);
                } catch (...) {
                    client->video_receiver->abort();
                    throw;
                }

                if (output.empty())
                    continue;

                kind = 3;
            } else {
                throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported incoming frame type");
            }

            if (output.size() + 1 > capacity)
                throw std::runtime_error("Receive buffer is too small");

            std::memcpy(buffer, output.data(), output.size());
            buffer[output.size()] = 0;
            *event_type = kind;

            last_error.clear();
            return static_cast<int>(output.size());
        }
    } catch (const FrameTimeoutError& e) {
        if (client && client->fd >= 0) {
            shutdown(client->fd, SHUT_RDWR);
            close(client->fd);
            client->fd = -1;
        }
        set_error(e.what());
        return -1;
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        set_error(e.what());
        return -1;
    } catch (...) {
        set_error("Unknown receive error");
        return -1;
    }
}

int capi_client_receive(
    CAPIClient* client, char* buffer, size_t capacity, int timeout_ms
) {
    int event_type = 0;

    int result = capi_client_receive_event(
        client, &event_type, buffer, capacity, timeout_ms
    );

    if (result < 0)
        return result;

    if (event_type != 1) {
        set_error("Received media event; use receive_event() instead");
        return -1;
    }

    return result;
}

void capi_client_close(CAPIClient* client) {
    if (!client || client->fd < 0)
        return;

    shutdown(client->fd, SHUT_RDWR);
    ::close(client->fd);
    client->fd = -1;
}

void capi_client_destroy(CAPIClient* client) {
    if (!client)
        return;

    capi_client_close(client);
    delete client;
}

}

FILE: src/auth.cpp

#include "auth.hpp"

#include <openssl/crypto.h>
#include <openssl/rand.h>
#include <openssl/sha.h>

#include <array>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdio>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <sstream>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <sys/stat.h>

AuthStore::AuthStore(const std::string& file) : path(file) {
    std::ifstream input(path);
    std::string username, first, second;

    while (input >> username >> first) {
        UserRecord record;

        if (first.size() == 64) {
            record.user_id = generate_user_id();
            record.ckey_hash = first;
        } else {
            record.user_id = first;
            if (!(input >> record.ckey_hash))
                break;
        }

        if (valid_username(username) &&
            record.user_id.size() == 32 &&
            record.ckey_hash.size() == 64) {
            users[username] = record;
        }
    }

    if (std::filesystem::exists(path)) {
        chmod(path.c_str(), 0600);
        save_locked();
    }
}

bool AuthStore::valid_username(const std::string& username) {
    if (username.size() < 3 || username.size() > 24)
        return false;

    for (unsigned char c : username) {
        if (!std::isalnum(c) && c != 95 && c != 45 && c != 46)
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}

std::string AuthStore::hash_key(const std::string& key) {
    unsigned char digest[SHA256_DIGEST_LENGTH];
    SHA256(reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(key.data()),
           key.size(), digest);

    std::ostringstream output;
    output << std::hex << std::setfill(static_cast<char>(48));

    for (unsigned char byte : digest)
        output << std::setw(2) << static_cast<unsigned int>(byte);

    return output.str();
}

std::string AuthStore::generate_user_id() {
    std::array<unsigned char, 16> bytes{};

    if (RAND_bytes(bytes.data(), static_cast<int>(bytes.size())) != 1)
        throw std::runtime_error("Secure UserID generation failed");

    std::ostringstream output;
    output << std::hex << std::setfill(static_cast<char>(48));

    for (unsigned char byte : bytes)
        output << std::setw(2) << static_cast<unsigned int>(byte);

    return output.str();
}

void AuthStore::save_locked() const {
    const std::string temporary = path + ".tmp";
    std::ofstream output(temporary, std::ios::trunc);

    if (!output)
        throw std::runtime_error("Cannot write user database");

    for (const auto& entry : users)
        output << entry.first << " " << entry.second.user_id
               << " " << entry.second.ckey_hash << "\n";

    output.flush();
    if (!output)
        throw std::runtime_error("User database write failed");

    output.close();
    chmod(temporary.c_str(), 0600);

    if (std::rename(temporary.c_str(), path.c_str()) != 0)
        throw std::runtime_error("Cannot replace user database");

    chmod(path.c_str(), 0600);
}

bool AuthStore::register_user(
    const std::string& username, std::string& ckey
) {
    std::string user_id;
    return register_user(username, ckey, user_id);
}

bool AuthStore::register_user(
    const std::string& username, std::string& ckey,
    std::string& user_id
) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);

    if (!valid_username(username) || users.count(username))
        return false;

    std::array<unsigned char, 32> random_bytes{};

    if (RAND_bytes(random_bytes.data(),
                   static_cast<int>(random_bytes.size())) != 1)
        throw std::runtime_error("Secure CKey generation failed");

    std::ostringstream token;
    token << std::hex << std::setfill(static_cast<char>(48));

    for (unsigned char byte : random_bytes)
        token << std::setw(2) << static_cast<unsigned int>(byte);

    ckey = token.str();
    user_id = generate_user_id();

    users[username] = {user_id, hash_key(ckey)};

    try {
        save_locked();
    } catch (...) {
        users.erase(username);
        ckey.clear();
        user_id.clear();
        throw;
    }

    return true;
}

bool AuthStore::authenticate(
    const std::string& username, const std::string& ckey
) const {
    std::string user_id;
    return authenticate(username, ckey, user_id);
}

bool AuthStore::authenticate(
    const std::string& username, const std::string& ckey,
    std::string& user_id
) const {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);

    auto found = users.find(username);
    if (found == users.end() || ckey.size() != 64)
        return false;

    std::string supplied = hash_key(ckey);

    if (CRYPTO_memcmp(found->second.ckey_hash.data(),
                      supplied.data(), supplied.size()) != 0)
        return false;

    user_id = found->second.user_id;
    return true;
}

#include "auth.hpp"

#include <openssl/crypto.h>
#include <openssl/rand.h>
#include <openssl/sha.h>

#include <array>
#include <cctype>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <sstream>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <sys/stat.h>

AuthStore::AuthStore(const std::string& file) : path(file) {
    std::ifstream input(path);
    std::string username, hash;

    while (input >> username >> hash) {
        if (valid_username(username) && hash.size() == 64)
            users[username] = hash;
    }

    if (std::filesystem::exists(path))
        chmod(path.c_str(), 0600);
}

bool AuthStore::valid_username(const std::string& username) {
    if (username.size() < 3 || username.size() > 24)
        return false;

    for (unsigned char c : username) {
        if (!std::isalnum(c) && c != _ && c != - && c != .)
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}

std::string AuthStore::hash_key(const std::string& key) {
    unsigned char digest[SHA256_DIGEST_LENGTH];
    SHA256(reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(key.data()),
           key.size(), digest);

    std::ostringstream output;
    output << std::hex << std::setfill(chr(48));

    for (unsigned char byte : digest)
        output << std::setw(2) << static_cast<unsigned int>(byte);

    return output.str();
}

void AuthStore::save_locked() const {
    const std::string temporary = path + ".tmp";
    std::ofstream output(temporary, std::ios::trunc);

    if (!output)
        throw std::runtime_error("Cannot write user database");

    for (const auto& entry : users)
        output << entry.first << " " << entry.second << "\n";

    output.flush();
    if (!output)
        throw std::runtime_error("User database write failed");

    output.close();
    chmod(temporary.c_str(), 0600);

    if (std::rename(temporary.c_str(), path.c_str()) != 0)
        throw std::runtime_error("Cannot replace user database");

    chmod(path.c_str(), 0600);
}

bool AuthStore::register_user(
    const std::string& username, std::string& ckey
) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);

    if (!valid_username(username) || users.count(username))
        return false;

    std::array<unsigned char, 32> random_bytes{};

    if (RAND_bytes(random_bytes.data(),
                   static_cast<int>(random_bytes.size())) != 1)
        throw std::runtime_error("Secure CKey generation failed");

    std::ostringstream token;
    token << std::hex << std::setfill(chr(48));

    for (unsigned char byte : random_bytes)
        token << std::setw(2) << static_cast<unsigned int>(byte);

    ckey = token.str();
    users[username] = hash_key(ckey);

    try {
        save_locked();
    } catch (...) {
        users.erase(username);
        ckey.clear();
        throw;
    }

    return true;
}

bool AuthStore::authenticate(
    const std::string& username, const std::string& ckey
) const {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);

    auto found = users.find(username);
    if (found == users.end() || ckey.size() != 64)
        return false;

    std::string supplied = hash_key(ckey);

    return CRYPTO_memcmp(
        found->second.data(), supplied.data(), supplied.size()
    ) == 0;
}


==========================================================================================
FILE: src/client.cpp
==========================================================================================
#include "commands.hpp"
#include "debug.hpp"
#include "library.hpp"
#include "image.hpp"
#include "logger.hpp"
#include "transport.hpp"
#include "neon.hpp"
#include "video.hpp"
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <iostream>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <thread>

constexpr uint16_t PORT = 8080;

static void transmit(int fd, LibraryManager& libraries,
                     Neon::Stats& stats, const std::string& message) {
    const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    std::string encoded = libraries.encode(message);
    const auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    const double ms =
        std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(end - start).count();

    Neon::encode(
        std::to_string(message.size()) + " chars | " +
        std::to_string(encoded.size() / 64) + " tokens | " +
        std::to_string(encoded.size()) + " bytes | " +
        std::to_string(ms) + " ms"
    );

    CipherTransport::send_frame(fd, CipherTransport::TEXT, encoded);

    ++stats.sent_messages;
    stats.sent_chars += message.size();
    stats.sent_tokens += encoded.size() / 64;
    stats.sent_bytes += encoded.size();

    Neon::send("Text frame transmitted");
}

static void transmit_fast(int fd, Neon::Stats& stats,
                          const std::string& message) {
    CipherTransport::send_frame(fd, CipherTransport::FAST_TEXT, message);

    ++stats.sent_messages;
    stats.sent_chars += message.size();
    stats.sent_bytes += message.size();

    Neon::info("FAST text | " + std::to_string(message.size()) + " raw bytes");
    Neon::send("Binary text frame transmitted");
}

static void transmit_image(int fd, Neon::Stats& stats,
                           const std::string& path) {
    const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    std::string packet = ImageLibrary::pack(path);

    const auto packed = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    CipherTransport::send_frame(fd, CipherTransport::IMAGE, packet);

    const auto sent = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    const double pack_ms =
        std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(packed - start).count();

    const double send_ms =
        std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(sent - packed).count();

    ++stats.sent_messages;
    stats.sent_bytes += packet.size();

    Neon::info(
        "Image packet | " + std::to_string(packet.size()) +
        " bytes | pack " + std::to_string(pack_ms) +
        " ms | send " + std::to_string(send_ms) + " ms"
    );

    Neon::send("Image transmitted successfully");
}

static void transmit_raw_image(int fd, Neon::Stats& stats,
                               const std::string& path) {
    const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    std::string packet = ImageLibrary::pack_raw(path);
    const auto packed = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    CipherTransport::send_frame(fd, CipherTransport::RAW_IMAGE, packet);
    const auto sent = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    double pack_ms =
        std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(packed - start).count();
    double send_ms =
        std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(sent - packed).count();

    ++stats.sent_messages;
    stats.sent_bytes += packet.size();

    Neon::info("RAW image | " + std::to_string(packet.size()) +
               " bytes | pack " + std::to_string(pack_ms) +
               " ms | send " + std::to_string(send_ms) + " ms");
    Neon::send("Raw image transmitted (no SHA-256)");
}


static void transmit_video(int fd, const LibraryManager& libraries,
                           Neon::Stats& stats, const std::string& path,
                           bool use_sha256, bool fast_mode) {
    const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    auto result = CipherVideo::send_file(
        fd, libraries, path, use_sha256, fast_mode
    );

    const auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    const double seconds =
        std::chrono::duration<double>(end - start).count();

    ++stats.sent_messages;
    stats.sent_bytes += result.wire_bytes;

    Neon::info(
        "CVS/1 | " + std::to_string(result.original_bytes) +
        " original bytes | " + std::to_string(result.wire_bytes) +
        " wire bytes | " + std::to_string(result.chunks) +
        " chunks | " + std::to_string(seconds) + " seconds"
    );

    Neon::send(
        use_sha256
            ? "Video transmitted with SHA-256"
            : "Video transmitted without SHA-256"
    );
}

int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
    int sock = -1;

    try {
        Neon::banner("CLIENT");

        LibraryManager libraries("libraries");
        Neon::info("Translation engine initialized");
        Neon::info("Binary image transport initialized");

        sock = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
        if (sock < 0)
            throw std::runtime_error("Socket creation failed");

        sockaddr_in server{};
        server.sin_family = AF_INET;
        server.sin_port = htons(PORT);
        const char* server_ip = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "127.0.0.1";
        if (inet_pton(AF_INET, server_ip, &server.sin_addr) != 1)
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid IPv4 address");

        Neon::network(std::string("Connecting to ") +
                     server_ip + ":8080");

        if (connect(sock, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&server),
                    sizeof(server)) < 0)
            throw std::runtime_error("Connection failed");

        Neon::network("Connection established");
        Neon::info("Full-duplex text + binary communication enabled");
        Neon::show_help_hint();

        Neon::Stats stats;
            bool fast_mode = false;
        std::atomic<bool> connected{true};

        std::thread receiver([&]() {
            CipherVideo::Receiver video_receiver(libraries);
            try {
                uint8_t type = 0;
                std::string payload;

                while (connected &&
                       CipherTransport::receive_frame(sock, type, payload)) {
                    stats.received_bytes += payload.size();

                    if (type == CipherTransport::TEXT) {
                        stats.received_tokens += payload.size() / 64;

                        Neon::receive(
                            std::to_string(payload.size()) + " bytes | " +
                            std::to_string(payload.size() / 64) + " tokens"
                        );

                        const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
                        std::string message = libraries.decode(payload);
                        const auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

                        const double ms =
                            std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(
                                end - start).count();

                        ++stats.received_messages;
                        stats.received_chars += message.size();

                        Neon::decode(
                            std::to_string(payload.size() / 64) +
                            " tokens -> " + std::to_string(message.size()) +
                            " chars | " + std::to_string(ms) + " ms"
                        );

                        Neon::print_message("SERVER", message);

                        if (message == "/quit") {
                            connected = false;
                            shutdown(sock, SHUT_RDWR);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    else if (type == CipherTransport::FAST_TEXT) {
                            ++stats.received_messages;
                            stats.received_chars += payload.size();
                            Neon::receive("FAST text | " +
                                          std::to_string(payload.size()) +
                                          " raw bytes");
                            Neon::print_message("PEER", payload);

                            if (payload == "/quit") {
                                connected = false;
                                shutdown(sock, SHUT_RDWR);
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        else if (type == CipherTransport::RAW_IMAGE) {
                            Neon::receive("Raw image | " +
                                          std::to_string(payload.size()) +
                                          " bytes | no checksum");

                            std::string saved = ImageLibrary::unpack_raw(payload);
                            ++stats.received_messages;

                            Neon::info("Raw image saved without SHA-256 verification");
                            Neon::print_message("IMAGE", "Saved to " + saved);
                        }
                        else if (type == CipherTransport::VIDEO_START ||
                                 type == CipherTransport::VIDEO_DATA ||
                                 type == CipherTransport::VIDEO_END) {
                            if (type == CipherTransport::VIDEO_START)
                                Neon::receive("CVS/1 video transfer started");

                            std::string saved = video_receiver.handle(type, payload);

                            if (!saved.empty()) {
                                ++stats.received_messages;
                                Neon::decode("CVS/1 video reconstructed");
                                Neon::print_message("VIDEO", "Saved to " + saved);
                            }
                        }
                        else if (type == CipherTransport::IMAGE) {
                        Neon::receive(
                            "Binary image packet | " +
                            std::to_string(payload.size()) + " bytes"
                        );

                        const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
                        std::string saved =
                            ImageLibrary::unpack(payload);
                        const auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

                        const double ms =
                            std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(
                                end - start).count();

                        ++stats.received_messages;

                        Neon::decode(
                            "SHA-256 verified | " +
                            std::to_string(payload.size()) +
                            " bytes | " + std::to_string(ms) + " ms"
                        );

                        Neon::print_message("IMAGE", "Saved to " + saved);
                    }
                }
            } catch (const std::exception& e) {
                if (connected) Neon::error(e.what());
            }

            connected = false;
            shutdown(sock, SHUT_RDWR);
            Neon::network("Receive channel closed");
        });

        std::string message;

        while (connected) {
            Neon::prompt("CLIENT");

            if (!std::getline(std::cin, message)) {
                if (connected) {
                    try { transmit(sock, libraries, stats, "/quit"); }
                    catch (...) {}
                }
                connected = false;
                shutdown(sock, SHUT_RDWR);
                break;
            }

            if (message == "/help") {
                Neon::help();
                continue;
            }

            if (message == "/stats") {
                Neon::show_stats(stats);
                continue;
            }

            if (message == "/clear") {
                Neon::clear();
                continue;
            }

            if (message == "/fast") {
                fast_mode = !fast_mode;
                Neon::info(std::string("FAST binary text mode ") +
                           (fast_mode ? "ENABLED" : "DISABLED"));
                continue;
            }

            if (message.rfind("/sendvid ", 0) == 0) {
                std::string argument = message.substr(9);
                bool no_sha = argument.rfind("-f ", 0) == 0;
                std::string path = no_sha ? argument.substr(3) : argument;

                if (path.size() >= 2 && path.front() == '"' && path.back() == '"')
                    path = path.substr(1, path.size() - 2);

                try {
                    transmit_video(sock, libraries, stats, path, !no_sha, fast_mode);
                } catch (const std::exception& e) {
                    Neon::error(e.what());
                }
                continue;
            }

            if (message.rfind("/sendimg ", 0) == 0) {
                std::string argument = message.substr(9);
                bool raw_mode = argument.rfind("-f ", 0) == 0;
                std::string path = raw_mode ? argument.substr(3) : argument;

                if (path.size() >= 2 &&
                    path.front() == '"' && path.back() == '"') {
                    path = path.substr(1, path.size() - 2);
                }

                try {
                    if (raw_mode)
                        transmit_raw_image(sock, stats, path);
                    else
                        transmit_image(sock, stats, path);
                } catch (const std::exception& e) {
                    Neon::error(e.what());
                }
                continue;
            }

            if (!connected) break;

            try {
                if (fast_mode)
                    transmit_fast(sock, stats, message);
                else
                    transmit(sock, libraries, stats, message);
            } catch (const std::exception& e) {
                Neon::error(e.what());
                connected = false;
                shutdown(sock, SHUT_RDWR);
                break;
            }

            if (message == "/quit") {
                connected = false;
                shutdown(sock, SHUT_RDWR);
                break;
            }
        }

        if (receiver.joinable()) receiver.join();

        close(sock);
        sock = -1;

        Neon::network("Client session closed");
        Neon::show_stats(stats);

    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        if (sock >= 0) {
            shutdown(sock, SHUT_RDWR);
            close(sock);
        }

        Neon::error(e.what());
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}


==========================================================================================
